newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-RONALDO KEEPS BARCELONA IN HUNT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RONALDO KEEPS BARCELONA IN HUNT.

text.p: Barcelona kept alive their Spanish league title hopes thanks to a superb piece of opportunism by Ronaldo in the last minute of their 1-0 win over Deportivo Coruna on Saturday.
The victory, which also ensures Barcelona a place in next season's European Cup, leaves the Catalan side two points behind leaders Real Madrid, who face a tough game at Athletic Bilbao on Sunday.

Despite numerous chances at both ends, the game had looked likely to end goalless until Ronaldo picked himself up from a heavy challenge and pounced upon a loose ball before giving Deportivo keeper Jacques Songo'o no chance.
The goal was Ronaldo's 34th of the season, but could easily be his last in a Barcelona shirt.
The Brazilian striker, who is likely to miss next weekend's game at Hercules because of international duty, has said he will reveal his plans for next season on Monday.
